system.description: The platinum dragon, an ascended mortal ruling over nobility and righteous authority, popular with rulers and Dragonborn; he values protecting the weak from the strong.
system.summary: The platinum dragon, an ascended mortal ruling over nobility and righteous authority, popular with rulers and Dragonborn; he values protecting the weak from the strong.
commandments: Hold to the highest standards of honor and justice.
Watch for evil everywhere and fight it on every front.
Shield the weak, free the oppressed and uphold rightful order.
directives: Behave decently in public, in private and in battle.
Resist the lure of power and serve crown and people.
Judge carefully and impartially, showing leniency to the needy.
Pledge yourself to a good ruler blessed by Bahamut.
Be fearless and steadfast like the Platinum Dragon.

cults.name: The Final Word of Kings
cults.summary: Solitary assassins who remove rulers they judge unfit, from petty bosses to emperors.

cults.name: Platinum Knights
cults.summary: Legendary elite warriors from remote fortress-monasteries, founded to fight Tiamat's minions above all.
